headline: Time Wizard
title: Time Wizard Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Time Wizard. What is it? It is a Level two LIGHT Spellcaster with five hundred attack. What does it do? Once per turn you toss a coin and call it. Call it right, and all your opponent's monsters are destroyed. Call it wrong, and your own monsters are destroyed and you take damage equal to half their total attack. How do you use it? It is risky, so use it when you have few monsters to lose. It is also a material for Thousand Dragon, with Baby Dragon. It appears in Joey's World. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
